q1_issues.issue: The to-infinitive complement is sealed as a nested (Implication ...) term in the Theme slot, but a control verb with a to-infinitive never seals (sealing is finite-clause-only) — the complement should be reified at top level with Theme pointing at its event witness and the object controller copied in as its subject role, as in 'urged the clerk to resign'.
Same sealing defect for the second coordinated complement (cherish).

q2_gaps: a reciprocal ('each other') complement under a control verb: the unnamed-group reciprocal must be an Implication rule, while the control pattern requires the complement at top level, where that rule would assert the mutual respect actually holds — the instruction set gives no way to reify a rule-shaped complement without asserting it
notes: Group witness for the definite plural, Recipient for the addressee, Experiencer/Stimulus for the psych verbs and the distinctness-guarded ordered-pair rule are all correct. Possession for 'the teacher of the kindergarten' is defensible under the relational-noun genitive route (teacher is an agent noun, not an act/result/quality nominalization).
